email_body:
Dear Weezevent team,

I'm applying for the Business Developer role in Antwerp. While my background is in digital marketing and web development, I've always been drawn to the energy of events and the challenge of winning new business. Your description of a tech-meets-events environment, where curiosity and humor are valued, resonates with me.

In my freelance work, I've had to prospect, build offers, and close deals with clients—often starting from a cold outreach or a referral. I've also supported sales teams by creating compelling online presences and lead-generating content. I'm fluent in English and comfortable in Dutch, and I'm eager to develop my consultative sales skills further.

I'm excited by the opportunity to contribute to Weezevent's growth in Belgium. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my drive and curiosity can translate into signing new customers.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Weezevent team,

I'm writing to apply for the Business Developer position in Antwerp. Although my CV highlights digital marketing and web development, I've long been fascinated by the events industry and the dynamic, tech-driven environment you describe. The opportunity to combine my commercial instincts with my technical background at a company that powers iconic festivals and major sporting events is incredibly appealing.

In my freelance work, I've had to be proactive in finding clients and closing projects. I've built websites from scratch, optimized them for search, and used data to demonstrate value—skills that translate well into consultative sales. I've also collaborated with sales teams by creating lead-generating content and ensuring our online presence converted visitors into enquiries. While I haven't held a formal sales title, I've consistently had to prospect, negotiate, and deliver results, often starting with cold outreach.

I'm bilingual in Dutch and English (with native Turkish), and I'm comfortable communicating with clients across Belgium. I'm eager to learn your sales methodology and contribute to acquiring new customers, from small businesses to key accounts. Your emphasis on curiosity, team spirit, and humor matches my own approach to work.

I'm excited about the chance to grow with Weezevent and help expand your Belgian footprint. I'd love to discuss how my drive and technical insight can support your sales team.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
